# Vouchly

> Vouchly is a testimonial collection and display platform for small businesses. Collect text and video testimonials from customers, polish them with AI, and embed a live testimonial wall on any website — all from a single script tag.

## Product

Vouchly helps business owners, consultants, coaches, agencies, and SaaS founders build social proof systems that convert visitors into customers. Key capabilities:

- **Testimonial collection**: Share a branded link; customers submit text or video testimonials in under 2 minutes
- **AI polish**: An AI rewriter turns vague responses into specific, compelling testimonials
- **Testimonial wall**: Embed a live, auto-updating grid of testimonials on any website with a single script tag
- **Analytics**: Proof Score™ tracks the impact of your testimonials over time
- **Video testimonials**: Collect and display video testimonials (Pro plan)
- **Custom domain**: Use your own domain for collection pages (Pro plan)

## Pricing

- **Free**: Up to 5 testimonials, 1 space, text only — free forever
- **Starter**: $19/month (or $17.10/month billed annually) — unlimited testimonials, 3 spaces, AI rewriter, remove branding
- **Pro**: $39/month (or $35.10/month billed annually) — everything in Starter plus video testimonials, unlimited spaces, custom domain, priority support

Annual plans save 10%.

## Company

Vouchly is a SaaS product built to help small businesses collect and leverage customer testimonials. The company is focused on the US market but serves customers globally.

Contact: support@vouchly.tech
